stem: An immunocompromised patient develops subacute granulomatous encephalitis. Brain tissue shows amoebic trophozoites and double-walled cysts. Which feature favors Acanthamoeba over Naegleria in this comparison?

options.text: Obligatory transmission by an Anopheles mosquito
options.explanation: Neither of these amoebic infections requires an Anopheles mosquito vector.

options.text: An exclusive location inside erythrocytes
options.explanation: The described brain tissue forms are not an erythrocytic parasite infection.

options.text: Presence of cyst forms within affected human tissue
options.explanation: Acanthamoeba can occur as trophozoites and cysts in human tissue and can cause a subacute granulomatous encephalitis.
